gate.merge.merge_policy.claim: Enforced by branch protection for non-admin merges; the fleet's merge paths do not use admin bypass, but GitHub does not prevent it while enforce_admins is false (measured 2026-10-07, Factory#943).
gate.merge.merge_policy.objective: The merge decision itself is deterministic: its own import closure reaches no model client.

gate.server.services.pr_endgame.claim: Enforced by branch protection for non-admin merges; the fleet's merge paths do not use admin bypass, but GitHub does not prevent it while enforce_admins is false (measured 2026-10-07, Factory#943).
gate.server.services.pr_endgame.objective: The endgame that applies the merge decision imports model clients; the review verdict it consumes is injected, not computed there.

gate.server.services.pr_review_service.claim: Enforced by branch protection for non-admin merges; the fleet's merge paths do not use admin bypass, but GitHub does not prevent it while enforce_admins is false (measured 2026-10-07, Factory#943).
gate.server.services.pr_review_service.objective: The review that feeds the merge verdict is model-assisted, and the page says so; it runs as a spawned runner whose model clients are found by following the declared spawn edge.

policy.overlay.objective: A high-risk or production deployment block, or an unsatisfied required system gate, holds the change for blocking approval before the tier is consulted; it can only tighten the decision.

policy.path_floor.objective: A change touching auth, secrets, migrations, infrastructure or CI paths is floored at blocking review, so a change cannot declare itself routine.

policy.tier.hard.claim: Enforced by branch protection for non-admin merges; the fleet's merge paths do not use admin bypass, but GitHub does not prevent it while enforce_admins is false (measured 2026-10-07, Factory#943).
policy.tier.hard.objective: A hard-tier change is never auto-merged; it is held for blocking human approval, which separates the author from the approver.

policy.tier.low.claim: Enforced by branch protection for non-admin merges; the fleet's merge paths do not use admin bypass, but GitHub does not prevent it while enforce_admins is false (measured 2026-10-07, Factory#943).
policy.tier.low.objective: A low-tier change auto-merges only when host CI is green, TFactory passed, the achieved VAL meets the floor and CI parity holds; otherwise it is held for async review.

policy.tier.medium.claim: Enforced by branch protection for non-admin merges; the fleet's merge paths do not use admin bypass, but GitHub does not prevent it while enforce_admins is false (measured 2026-10-07, Factory#943).
policy.tier.medium.objective: A medium-tier change is never auto-merged; it is always held for asynchronous human review.

policy.val_floor.objective: A change whose achieved Verification Assurance Level is missing or below its declared floor is not auto-merged, and an unreadable floor fails closed.

wiring.auto_merge_flag.objective: Auto-merge is off by default and is enabled only by an explicit per-project or per-deployment setting.

wiring.blank_tier.objective: A task with no recorded review tier is decided as low, so the live merge path treats a blank tier exactly as the policy treats low.

wiring.live_overlay.objective: On the live merge path a high risk or production deployment holds the merge for a human regardless of the path-floor flag; a required human-approval gate clears only on a GitHub approval of the head commit by someone other than the PR author or a bot; an unreadable contract holds it too.

wiring.path_floor_flag.objective: The path-derived risk floor is advisory by default and changes the merge tier only when enforcement is explicitly switched on.
